column1: # Expected-abstain canonicality edges, against a mastodon checkout. Proposed
# format — no harness reads this yet; see the README ("Expected abstentions").
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER.
# Each row asserts that NEITHER side is the implementation the other shadows,
# so the correct canonicality answer is to decline (DEC-019). Declining here
# is scored as right; naming either side is scored as wrong.
# Format: a<TAB>b<TAB>why[<TAB>provisional], why from a small vocabulary:
#   siblings     born in one commit; no copy direction exists in history
#   front_doors  each copy is the live entry point of its own stack; the true
#                home is an extraction that has not happened yet
# One copy serves every rack request (config/application.rb), the other every
# sidekiq job (config/initializers/sidekiq.rb). The consolidation target is a
# NEW shared module — crowning either existing copy would be wrong.
# Two live API versions of the same behaviour; v1 is kept for client compat,
# v2 is current. Provisional: a product owner might rule v2 canonical.
